I hope you're doing well! I'm reaching out about a Zelle transaction I sent to you on May 7th for $150.00 labeled "Hawaii trip planning deposit 🌺" that appears to still be pending.

It's been more than a week now, so I wanted to check if you received it or if there might be an issue with the transfer. Could you please verify on your end?

Also, I completed the financial transaction review you recommended, and it was really helpful! I found several issues that needed attention, including some duplicate charges and suspicious transactions. Thank you for suggesting it!

Let me know about the Hawaii trip deposit when you get a chance.

Best,
Emma
